title: Reference-Free Humanoid Skateboarding via Termination-Shaped Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 基于终止条件塑形强化学习的无参考人形机器人滑板控制
abstract_en: Humanoid locomotion research has advanced rapidly on walking and running, but \emph {object-mediated} locomotion, in which a robot must coordinate its body with a passive external object, remains difficult. One challenging task is skateboarding, which requires simultaneous interaction with the ground and a passive but movable platform to achieve forward motion. Current methods for tackling skateboarding with humanoid robots either require human demonstrations or utilise analytic steering models that require system identification. In this paper, we introduce a deep reinforcement learning framework that does not rely on prior data such as demonstrations and enables robots such as the K1 humanoid to learn to skateboard using model-free learning. The method combines task rewards with exploit-blocking terminations. We introduce a number of constraints restricting behaviours such as losing the planted board foot, standing with both feet on the board, excessive twisting, separation from the board, and unstable board motion. Their changing prevalence during training produces an implicit progression from stance control towards sustained robot--board locomotion.
abstract_zh: 与步行和跑步不同，滑板运动要求人形机器人同时与地面和可移动的被动滑板交互，协调身体与滑板以实现前进。现有方法依赖人类示范，或使用需要系统辨识的解析转向模型。本文提出一种无模型深度强化学习框架，使 K1 等人形机器人无需人类示范或其他先验数据即可学习滑板运动。该框架将任务奖励与回合终止条件结合，防止策略通过抬起支撑脚、双脚同时踩板、过度扭转、与滑板分离或使滑板运动失稳等非预期行为取巧。随着各类终止条件的触发频率在训练中变化，学习过程自然地从站姿控制过渡到机器人与滑板的持续协同前进。
key_points_zh: 滑板是物体介导运动（object-mediated locomotion）任务：机器人必须同时协调与地面和被动滑板的接触。
采用无模型深度强化学习，不依赖人类示范，也不需要对解析转向模型进行系统辨识。
将任务奖励与回合终止条件结合，限制支撑脚离板、双脚同时踩板、过度扭转等非预期行为。
各类终止条件的触发频率随训练变化，形成从站姿控制到持续协同前进的隐式课程。
